posts.topic: Instant Payments Overtook ACH And Wire
posts.hook: Money moves continuously now. Most treasury operations still run on banking hours.
posts.key_stat: Instant payments led ACH and wire by more than 15 percentage points as the most-used US business payment method in 2025.
posts.source: DXC, Treasury Management Trends and Priorities for 2026
posts.visual_direction: Clean stat card foregrounding the 15+ percentage-point lead, framing the batch-era-to-continuous-settlement gap for a CFO audience.
